context.text: first two layers done without the guide!!
WITHOUT the guide, Leo. That's the cube starting to make sense. Sunday's a rest day.

transcript.text: yo how'd I do this week

Leo, solid week! 🔥
• You showed up for all 6 step days, every one in full.
• You went from the white cross on Monday to white corners Tuesday and middle layer edges Wednesday.
• Your best time on the first two layers dropped from 4:10 Thursday to 3:40 Friday to 3:05 Saturday.
• Saturday you did it without the guide, and you said the edge insert finally makes sense.

What felt best this week, and what do you want to push on next?
honestly I want to solve the whole thing by next weekend

That's the goal: the whole cube, no guide, by Saturday Nov 14. You've got two layers down, so the last layer is the only part left. 💪

Tomorrow at 9 pm at your desk, you learn the yellow cross on the last layer, 15 min. Warm up with a couple of full first-two-layers solves first, then send me a timer screenshot like usual. Work for you?
also kinda want to start juggling on the side lol
Love that. Let me think on it. 😄 For now, the cube is the mission: finish the last layer by Saturday. Does tomorrow's yellow cross at 9 pm work for you?
Locked in. Tomorrow, 9 pm, yellow cross. Go get it, Leo! 🧩
